messages:
release-bot: Starting release window: publishing py/ts SDK packages (v2.3.9 -> v2.4.0). change-window: 2026-03-20 16:00-17:00 UTC. tagging: release/py-ts/v2.4.0 :rocket:
Jamie Park: kicking off from my side, will run canary publish to staging first. Anita, can you watch the wheel upload creds?
Maya Chen: on it. I rotated the PYPI_TOKEN earlier today — confirming the staging token has upload perms. :thumbsup:
Leo Martinez: heads up, integration tests against auth mock will run at +5m after publish. if they fail we should hold canary.
Jamie Park: copying commands here for canary publish:
```bash
python -m build
python -m twine upload --repository-url https://test.pypi.org/legacy/ dist/* 
# for TS: npm publish --tag canary --access public
```
Maya Chen: running python build now, pushing to test.pypi. will post logs.
release-bot: twine upload to test.pypi returned 403 for package redwood-inference-sdk-2.4.0rc1-py3-none-any.whl at 1938475651
Maya Chen: ah, 403 on staging. checking token scopes: PACKAGES_READ only, not upload. I must've copied the wrong secret.
Anita Singh: I can rotate the staging token and push a new secret to the repo. doing rotation now. ETA ~3m.
Jamie Park: hold on CI. do not tag npm yet. We'll retry after Anita rotates creds.
Anita Singh: rotated. I updated repo secret `TEST_PYPI_TOKEN` and redeployed the actions runner.
Maya Chen: re-running twine upload...
release-bot: twine upload to test.pypi succeeded at 1938475688 for redwood-inference-sdk-2.4.0rc1
Leo Martinez: integration tests triggered, running.
Leo Martinez: integration tests: all green except embedding-rerank smoke, investigating latency regression on canary :eyes:
Jamie Park: how bad is the regression? we need decide rollback vs tweak batching.
Leo Martinez: p50 increased from 80ms -> 160ms on embedding-rerank test. looks like quantization variant selected a slower kernel for longer sequences.
Anita Singh: can we pin the canary to the previous quantization profile (q4_0) for the canary cohort while we investigate?
Jamie Park: yes — for canary publish we can set PKG_QUANT_PROFILE=q4_0 in the release job to pin behavior. We should not push that to stable yet.
Maya Chen: I've re-tagged the package as canary-pin-q4 and published to test.pypi. npm canary still pending.
release-bot: npm canary publish succeeded at 1938475712 with tag canary-pin-q4
Leo Martinez: re-ran integration tests against canary-pin-q4: embedding-rerank latency back to baseline. Good.
Jamie Park: ok plan: advance to staged publish but keep stable release blocked until ML/infra finds root cause. we'll include deprecation note for old sync client in the release notes draft but mark stable release as blocked.
Anita Singh: I'll open a short incident note and request infra-week time for kernel repro: GH issue #1892.
Maya Chen: release notes draft (short):
- v2.4.0 (pending): Introduces async client improvements, structured tool-calling helpers, and an updated embedding pipeline.
- Note: stable rollout paused due to embedding latency regression with new quantization path. Canary pinned to q4_0.
- Deprecation: legacy sync client (sync.Client) slated for removal in v3.0, add migration examples.
Jamie Park: +1. I'll add the PR links and changelog entry, and set the release to "staged (canary pinned)" in the console.
release-bot: Deploy job for stable channel remains blocked due to flag: manual_approve_required by Jamie Park
Jamie Park: I'll approve stable once we have a fix or decide to ship with pinned quantization and a mitigation ticket. ETA by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maya Chen: sanity check — do we want to publish the npm latest as well? I vote no, keep npm latest unchanged until stable approved.
Jamie Park: agreed. npm latest stays. canary only.
Leo Martinez: follow-up action: ML infra to reproduce kernel selection and add a fallback in runtime. assigning to @infra-mike in GH issue.
Anita Singh: created incident note and added release link + rollback checklist.
Jamie Park: thanks all. I'll update the release thread in the console and we can reconvene if anything changes. :raised_hands:
